items.headline: Netherlands to Fight Rollout of Proposed US Curbs on ASML
items.excerpt: The Dutch government said it will resist US plans to further restrict ASML Holding NV’s sales to China, calling the proposed rules a threat to Europe’s most valuable company and widening a rift with Washington.

items.headline: SAP Weighs Cutting at Least 10,000 Positions in AI Restructuring
items.excerpt: SAP SE is preparing a plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions to transform its software business for the artificial intelligence era, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: FIFA Says Hackers Accessed Personal Data in Cyberattack
items.excerpt: FIFA was targeted by a cyberattack that resulted in hackers accessing “personal and business information,” the football governing body said in a statement on Thursday.

items.headline: QRT to Merge $2 Billion Hedge Fund With Flagship Qube Strategy
items.excerpt: Qube Research & Technologies, one of the fastest growing investment firms in the world, is set to merge its crypto-focused money pool with its flagship hedge fund strategy.

items.headline: Africa’s Intra-Continental Trade Hit $213.8 Billion But Faces Payment Barriers
items.excerpt: The value of trade between African nations rose about 6% last year to $213.8 billion, but accounted for only 14.6% of the continent’s total trade due to regional economic integration challenges, according to a study.

items.headline: StanChart’s Crypto Custody Unit Suffers Data Breach
items.excerpt: Standard Chartered’s crypto custody subsidiary Zodia Custody Ltd. said it had suffered a security breach, exposing some client and staff information.

items.headline: TrustedRouter Aims to Give Companies Greater Privacy With AI
items.excerpt: The startup offers companies a way to keep employees’ AI use private from model makers

items.headline: Investec Sees Opportunities in Three Key AI Buckets
items.excerpt: Jimmy Muchechetere, equity research analyst at Investec, says the AI trade isn't over and there are value opportunities across the spectrum. He speaks on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: ElevenLabs in Early Talks for Funding at $33 Billion Value
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs, a company building artificial intelligence voice models and agents, is in early discussions for a funding round at a target valuation of $33 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

items.headline: Marc Levinson on How UPS Created Modern Logistics
items.excerpt: UPS was founded nearly a century ago in the basement of a Seattle saloon by James E. Casey and his business partner Claude Ryan. items.headline: Anthropic’s Stock Sparks Divide Inside One Wall Street Firm
items.excerpt: Two equity analysts at a single Wall Street research firm have taken the unusual step of posting conflicting views on the outlook for the hottest stock in the market: Anthropic PBC’s newly listed shares.

items.headline: AI Trade Rebounds in Late Buying Ahead of US Holiday
items.excerpt: Stocks rose alongside US equity-index futures as investors returned to the artificial intelligence trade in the runup to the Thanksgiving holiday after a week of whipsawing. Bloomberg's Neil Campling has more. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.headline: Banks Risk Outages as They Contend With AI Threats
items.excerpt: The risk of cyberattacks is forcing banks to contend with a growing number of technical hiccups as they race to adapt aging infrastructure and find vulnerabilities before they’re exploited. items.headline: Philippine Investors Explore Stablecoins to Buy Retail Bonds
items.excerpt: About 1,200 Philippine investors used digital tokens to fund roughly $1 million of retail dollar bond purchases after the Southeast Asian nation opened a new channel for investing in government debt.

items.headline: Malaysia Removes About 40,000 Bullying Posts in Online Crackdown
items.excerpt: Malaysia said online platforms removed more than 40,000 pieces of bullying-related content this year at the government’s request, as the Southeast Asian nation steps up efforts to protect children from harmful material on social media.

items.headline: Apple to Expand India Retail Network With New Store in Hyderabad
items.excerpt: Apple Inc. is opening a new store in the southern Indian city of Hyderabad next month, continuing a drive to expand its retail network in one of its fastest-growing overseas markets.

items.headline: Musk Says Every US Kid to Get Two SpaceX Shares, Doubling Pledge
items.excerpt: Elon Musk and SpaceX will give every child in the US two shares in the space exploration company, doubling a commitment the world’s richest person made just last month.

items.headline: Xpeng Says Its Humanoid Robot Will Cost the Same as an EV
items.excerpt: Xpeng Inc.’s humanoid robots will cost roughly the same as an electric vehicle when they go on sale to the public in the second quarter.

items.headline: Huawei Teases Next-Gen AI Memory Chip to Take On Samsung, Hynix
items.excerpt: Huawei Technologies Co. is preparing to release details of a new high-bandwidth memory chip that could potentially surpass current offerings from Samsung Electronics Co. and SK Hynix Inc., moving to launch Chinese production of a key AI component currently blocked by US sanctions.

items.headline: Viettel, Singtel Building Subsea Cable for Data-Hungry Vietnam
items.excerpt: A consortium led by Viettel Group and Singapore Telecommunications is beginning construction on a submarine cable system in Ho Chi Minh City as Vietnam’s demand for internet bandwidth rapidly grows.
